scope: Independent line-by-line re-review of the committed canonical workspace against official sources, re-verified live via fetch_page on 2026-11-14 UTC. Review is bounded: it re-checks the official sources the project cites and compares them to the committed snapshots. It is not an exhaustive certification of every inherited file.
method: Re-fetched official pages with fetch_page (curl is blocked in the sandbox); compared rendered official content to committed JSON/HTML snapshots; left unconfirmed values blank and flagged. Every row links its official source. Source links are retrieval/verification targets, not proof of any derived number.

findings.finding: The canonical snapshot is dated 2026-11-04, but the live official Week 9 schedule now renders every Week 9 game as FINAL with scores. As of 2026-11-14, Week 9 is complete and a Week 10 injury report exists. The canonical site presents Week 9 lines, injuries and availability as the current view.
findings.evidence: nfl.com/schedules/2026/by-week/week-9 shows JAX 33, BAL 10 FINAL (Nov 5); CIN 34, ATL 17 FINAL (Nov 8); etc.
findings.impact: Line-origination, injury and availability content is stale by two weeks; 'current' labels overstate freshness. Strategy promotion and availability gates that depend on 'current' inputs are affected.

findings.finding: The official Week 9 injury page at /injuries/league/2026/reg9 renders a report body labeled 'WEEK 9', while the page <title> reads 'Week 10 of the 2026 Season'. The week selector lists WEEK 1..WEEK 10.
findings.evidence: Retrieved 2026-11-14: title 'Official NFL Injury Report for Players - Week 10 of the 2026 Season | NFL.com'; body header 'Injuries - WEEK 9'.
findings.impact: Automated week parsing keyed on the <title> could mislabel the report week. Any scraper should key on the body label or URL, not the title.

findings.finding: The canonical pages/injuries.html leaves the Injury and Game Status cells blank for the transcribed JAX/BAL rows, but the official Week 9 injury report publishes both the injury type and the game status for those same players.
findings.evidence: Official report: Lamar Jackson (QB) 'Thumb' / Out; Tyler Huntley (QB) 'Toe' / Out; Bhayshul Tuten (RB) 'Ankle, Foot' / Questionable; Travon Walker (DE) 'Rib' / Questionable; Jaylinn Hawkins (S) 'Knee' / Out; Nate Wiggins (CB) 'Stinger, Illness' / Questionable.
findings.impact: Verified official values were withheld. This does not create false precision, but it withholds available evidence needed for the availability gate (G4) and lineup-impact signals.

findings.finding: The canonical injury capture transcribed only the JAX/BAL game (28 rows). The official Week 9 report contains all 14 Week 9 games, each with a full player table. Prior flag F-22 is confirmed by the live page.
findings.evidence: Live /reg9 page includes JAX@BAL, CIN@ATL, DAL@IND, NYJ@KC, DET@MIA, CLE@NO, LA@WAS, HOU@LAC, LV@SF, GB@NE, AZ@SEA, TB@CHI, BUF@MIN and the Madrid game.
findings.impact: Availability evidence is incomplete across the slate; per-game availability gates cannot be evaluated for the uncaptured games.

findings.finding: The Week 9 schedule source now embeds final scores and each team's current record. The canonical 'schedule & scores' snapshot was captured pre-game (15 matchups, byes PIT/TEN) and no longer matches the live page content.
findings.evidence: Live schedule page shows final scores (e.g., Jaguars 33, Ravens 10) and records (JAX 6-2, BAL 4-5) next to each Week 9 game.
findings.impact: The committed schedule snapshot and the live source have diverged. A fresh capture is required before any schedule-derived value is reused.

findings.finding: Re-captured the 32-team league standings on 2026-11-14. Spot arithmetic on the captured rows reconciles: PCT equals (W+0.5*T)/GP and PF-PA equals the NET column for the rows reviewed. No mismatch was found in the re-captured standings.
findings.evidence: 32 rows captured across 2 chunks from nfl.com/standings/league/2026/REG; e.g., NYG 5-3-1, PCT 0.611 = 5.5/9; LAC 0-8, PCT 0.000.
findings.impact: The standings foundation is internally consistent on re-verification. This confirms the source is live and the field labels (W/L/T/PCT/PF/PA/NET/HOME/ROAD/DIV/CONF/STRK) are correct.
